'''Glasswater Run''' was the name given to the southern side of the [[Icefall Plains/Legends|Icefall Plains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. A wide tundra, the area was the location of [[Zero Station]], the [[Talz Training Camp]], and the [[Drift Hills Stronghold]].<ref name="TOR" />
